note: C1 deepens B1's basic nominalisation (Einheit 10) and B1's single Genitiv-prepositions (Einheit 7) into the real density of bureaucratic and academic German: several genitive and prepositional attributes piled onto one head noun instead of one at a time.

examples.de: Der Nominalstil mit gestaffelten Attributen ist typisch für Verwaltungssprache, Gesetzestexte und wissenschaftliche Texte.
examples.en: Nominal style with stacked attributes is typical of administrative language, legal texts, and academic writing.

english: a genitive chain (a genitive inside a genitive)
note: One genitive attribute can itself contain another — the head noun is modified by a genitive phrase which is itself modified by a further genitive phrase. Two links is normal in formal writing; three starts to feel unwieldy even in Amtsdeutsch.

examples.de: Die Rechte der Kinder der Angestellten wurden im neuen Tarifvertrag gestärkt.
examples.en: The rights of the employees' children were strengthened in the new collective agreement.

english: a genitive attribute and a prepositional attribute combined
note: Rather than chaining genitive after genitive, formal German often mixes one genitive attribute with one prepositional attribute on the same head noun — usually easier to read than a long genitive chain, and the more common real-world pattern.

examples.de: Die Erhöhung der Recyclingquote im Rahmen der neuen Verordnung betrifft alle Kommunen.
examples.en: The increase in the recycling quota under the new regulation affects all municipalities.

english: within the framework of, as part of
note: A very common formal preposition governing the genitive — introduces the larger process, plan, or set of rules that something belongs to.

examples.de: Im Rahmen der Reform werden neue Zuständigkeiten geschaffen.
examples.en: As part of the reform, new areas of responsibility are being created.

english: in the course of, in the process of
note: Similar to im Rahmen, but emphasises an ongoing process or development rather than a fixed set of rules — im Zuge der Digitalisierung, im Zuge der Verhandlungen.

examples.de: Im Zuge der Digitalisierung wurden viele Verfahren vereinfacht.
examples.en: In the course of digitalisation, many procedures were simplified.

note: Introduces a fact that explains or justifies what follows — close to angesichts (B1 Unit 7), just more explicitly weighing the fact as a consideration.

examples.de: In Anbetracht der hohen Kosten wurde das Projekt verschoben.
examples.en: In view of the high costs, the project was postponed.

english: in favour of, to the benefit of
note: States who benefits from a decision or change — the natural opposite is zulasten.

examples.de: Die Regelung wurde zugunsten der Mieter geändert.
examples.en: The regulation was changed in favour of tenants.

english: at the expense of, to the detriment of
note: The opposite of zugunsten — states who bears the cost or disadvantage of a decision. Written as one word or two; both are standard.

examples.de: Die Kürzungen gehen vor allem zulasten der Ärmsten.
examples.en: The cuts are mainly at the expense of the poorest.

note: A very formal, mainly legal preposition — says that what follows still applies or holds, regardless of the thing just mentioned.

examples.de: Unbeschadet dieser Regelung bleibt der ursprüngliche Vertrag gültig.
examples.en: Notwithstanding this regulation, the original contract remains valid.

english: nominal style combined with an extended attribute
note: The two densest C1 constructions stack: a genitive/prepositional attribute (this unit) modifying a head noun that is itself inside an extended attribute (Unit 1, der vom Ministerium … beschlossene …). This is what genuinely dense official or academic German looks like.

examples.de: Die vom Ministerium im Rahmen der Reform beschlossene Erhöhung der Recyclingquote der Kommunen tritt im Januar in Kraft.
examples.en: The increase in municipalities' recycling quota, decided by the ministry as part of the reform, takes effect in January.

english: decompressing: unpacking a noun phrase into clauses
note: A reading strategy for dense Nominalstil, extending B1 Unit 10's Verbalisierung to multi-layered phrases: find the head noun and its verb first, then unpack each attribute — genitive or prepositional — into its own short clause, working outward from the core.

examples.de: Im Rahmen der neuen Verordnung wird die Recyclingquote der Kommunen erhöht. — die entpackte Version von "die Erhöhung der Recyclingquote der Kommunen im Rahmen der neuen Verordnung".
examples.en: As part of the new regulation, municipalities' recycling quota is being increased. — the unpacked version of "the increase in municipalities' recycling quota under the new regulation".

german: Komprimierung: Sätze zu einer Nominalphrase verdichten
english: compressing: condensing clauses into one noun phrase
note: The reverse move, needed for formal writing: take two or three plain clauses and fold them into one dense noun phrase — nominalise the main verb, turn the agent into a genitive or von-phrase, and add the surrounding circumstance as a prepositional attribute.

examples.de: Das Ministerium hat im Rahmen der Reform beschlossen, die Recyclingquote zu erhöhen. → die vom Ministerium im Rahmen der Reform beschlossene Erhöhung der Recyclingquote
examples.en: The ministry decided, as part of the reform, to increase the recycling quota. → the increase in the recycling quota decided by the ministry as part of the reform

note: An official rule issued by an authority or ministry, below the level of a full Gesetz — very common in im Rahmen/im Zuge phrases.

examples.de: Die neue Verordnung tritt im nächsten Monat in Kraft.
examples.en: The new regulation takes effect next month.

note: A target percentage set by policy or regulation — die Recyclingquote, die Frauenquote, die Erfolgsquote.

examples.de: Die Quote soll bis 2030 auf 65 Prozent steigen.
examples.en: The quota is meant to rise to 65 percent by 2030.

note: The local level of administration — a town, city, or district government; common in genitive chains about who is responsible or affected.

examples.de: Viele Kommunen können die Kosten nicht allein tragen.
examples.en: Many municipalities can't bear the costs alone.

note: A bundled set of policy steps announced together — from Maßnahme (B1) + Paket.

examples.de: Die Regierung hat ein umfangreiches Maßnahmenpaket beschlossen.
examples.en: The government has adopted a wide-ranging package of measures.

note: The formal act of awarding something — a contract, funding, a place — according to set criteria; from vergeben.

examples.de: Die Vergabe der Fördermittel erfolgt nach festen Kriterien.
examples.en: The allocation of the funding follows fixed criteria.

note: Putting a plan, law, or reform into practice — from umsetzen; very common paired with a genitive: die Umsetzung der Reform.

examples.de: Die Umsetzung der Reform verzögert sich um mehrere Monate.
examples.en: The implementation of the reform is being delayed by several months.

note: A formal session where affected parties or experts are heard before a decision — common in the run-up to a Verordnung or Gesetz.

examples.de: Vor der Entscheidung findet eine öffentliche Anhörung statt.
examples.en: A public hearing takes place before the decision.

note: A formal revision of an existing law — a legal sense distinct from the literary Novelle (novella); context makes clear which is meant.

examples.de: Die Novelle des Umweltgesetzes wurde im Bundestag verabschiedet.
examples.en: The amendment to the environmental law was passed in the Bundestag.

note: A compound noun (Regelung + Bedarf) naming the gap a new Verordnung or Gesetz is meant to fill — a classic Amtsdeutsch noun with no natural plural.

examples.de: Die Experten sehen dringenden Regelungsbedarf.
examples.en: The experts see an urgent need for regulation.

english: coming into force, entry into effect
note: The substantivised infinitive (B1 Unit 10 pattern) of in Kraft treten (B2's Funktionsverbgefüge unit) — names the moment a law or regulation starts to apply. No natural plural.

examples.de: Das Inkrafttreten des Gesetzes ist für Januar geplant.
examples.en: The law is scheduled to come into force in January.

note: A compound of Zuständigkeit (B1 Unit 4) + Bereich — the defined scope within which an office, ministry, or person is responsible.

examples.de: Das fällt nicht in meinen Zuständigkeitsbereich.
examples.en: That doesn't fall within my area of responsibility.

note: A government department — common as the agent in extended attributes and von-phrases: das vom Ministerium vorgelegte Konzept.

examples.de: Das zuständige Ministerium prüft den Vorschlag.
examples.en: The responsible ministry is reviewing the proposal.

note: A group formally appointed to decide or advise on something — ein unabhängiges Gremium, ein beratendes Gremium.

examples.de: Ein unabhängiges Gremium bewertet die Anträge.
examples.en: An independent panel assesses the applications.

note: A condition attached to a permit or approval — unter Auflagen genehmigen. A separate, unrelated sense means a print run/edition; context distinguishes them.

examples.de: Die Genehmigung wurde nur unter Auflagen erteilt.
examples.en: The approval was granted only subject to conditions.

note: A rule or target set in advance that something must meet — die gesetzlichen Vorgaben, die technischen Vorgaben.

examples.de: Die neuen Vorgaben gelten ab sofort für alle Betriebe.
examples.en: The new requirements apply to all businesses with immediate effect.

note: How far-reaching a decision or event is — von großer/weitreichender Tragweite. Used almost only in this fixed evaluative sense; no natural plural.

examples.de: Die Entscheidung hat weitreichende Tragweite.
examples.en: The decision has far-reaching significance.
